svg.text: ivr-main contact flow · IVR call flow
Single queue with language as an attribute; caller identification by ANI; returning callers routed to the case owner first; answered and unanswered (ringback and voicemail) paths
Find or create profile by ANI
Set vmx3_* flow attributes · Polly voice
Language is an attribute only · set vmx3_queue_arn
Look up open case · owner status
Lambda case-owner-lookup · queue directly on failure
Set agent whisper: case number + owner
Played before connect · English · digit by digit
Offer to owner first for 20 s
Then any agent in queue main
Play: unable to take your call
Whisper plays first if a case is open
Transcribed by language · KMS-encrypted in S3
Connects when an agent answers; then voicemail offer
Press 1 for voicemail, any other key to wait
